roles.title: Roles
roles.lead: Define who can do what in this group. Built-in roles ship with WiChat; custom roles are coming next.
roles.create_coming_soon: Creating custom roles is not available yet.
roles.default_role_description: Applies to all group members by default. Permissions set here act as the baseline.
roles.detail_lead: Permissions and members assigned to this role.
roles.detail_placeholder: Role permissions and member assignment will be configured here.

detail.everyone_display_readonly: The @everyone role name and color are fixed for all members.
detail.role_color_hint: Members use the color of the highest role they have on the roles list.
detail.role_icon_hint: Upload an image under 256 KB. We recommend at least 64×64 pixels. Members will see the icon for their highest role if they have multiple roles.
detail.icon_too_large: Role icon must be under 256 KB.
detail.hoist_label: Display role members separately from online members
detail.mentionable_hint: Note: Members with the Mention @everyone permission can always mention this role.
detail.perm_view_channels_desc: Allows members to view channels by default (excluding private channels).
detail.perm_manage_channels_desc: Allows members to create, edit, or delete channels.
detail.perm_manage_roles_desc: Allows members to create new roles and edit or delete roles lower than their highest role. Also allows members to change permissions of individual channels that they have access to.
detail.perm_manage_group_desc: Allows members to change this group's name, icon, banner, and general group settings.
detail.perm_create_expressions_desc: Allows members to add custom emoji, stickers, and sounds in this group.
detail.perm_manage_expressions_desc: Allows members to edit or remove custom emoji, stickers, and sounds in this group.
detail.perm_view_audit_log_desc: Allows members to view a record of who made which changes in this group.
detail.perm_view_group_insights_desc: Allows members to view Group Insights, which shows data on member growth, engagement, and channel activity.
detail.perm_manage_webhooks_desc: Allows members to create, edit, or delete webhooks that can post messages from other apps or sites into this group.
detail.perm_create_invite_desc: Allows members to invite new people to this group.
detail.perm_kick_members_desc: Kick will remove other members from this group (they can rejoin with another invite). If membership approval is enabled, this permission allows approving or rejecting join requests.
detail.perm_ban_members_desc: Allows members to permanently ban and delete the message history of other members from this group.
detail.perm_timeout_members_desc: When you put a user in timeout, they cannot send messages, reply in threads, react, or speak in voice channels.
detail.perm_send_messages_desc: Allows members to send messages in text channels and create posts in forum channels.
detail.perm_send_messages_in_threads: Send Messages in Threads and Posts
detail.perm_send_messages_in_threads_desc: Allows members to send messages in threads and in posts on forum channels.
detail.perm_create_public_threads_desc: Allows members to create threads that everyone in a channel can view.
detail.perm_create_private_threads_desc: Allows members to create invite-only threads.
detail.perm_embed_links_desc: Allows links that members share to show embedded content in text channels.
detail.perm_attach_files_desc: Allows members to upload files or media in text channels.
detail.perm_add_reactions_desc: Allows members to add new emoji reactions to a message. If this permission is disabled, members can still react using existing reactions.
detail.perm_mention_everyone_desc: Allows members to use @everyone or @here, and @mention all roles even if the role's mentionable toggle is disabled.
detail.perm_manage_messages_desc: Allows members to delete or remove embeds from messages by other members.
detail.perm_pin_messages_desc: Allows members to pin or unpin any message.
detail.perm_bypass_slowmode_desc: Allows members to send messages without being affected by channel slowmode.
detail.perm_manage_threads_desc: Allows members to rename, delete, close, and turn on slow mode for threads and posts. They can also view private threads.
detail.perm_read_message_history_desc: Allows members to read previous messages sent in channels. If disabled, members only see messages sent while they are online.
detail.perm_send_voice_messages_desc: Allows members to send voice messages.
detail.perm_connect_desc: Allows members to join voice channels and hear others.
detail.perm_speak_desc: Allows members to talk in voice channels. If disabled, members are muted by default until unmuted by a moderator.
detail.perm_video_desc: Allows members to share their camera video or screen share in voice channels.
detail.perm_use_voice_activity_desc: Allows members to speak in voice channels by simply talking. If disabled, Push-to-Talk is required.
detail.perm_use_soundboard_desc: Allows members to send sounds from the group soundboard.
detail.perm_priority_speaker_desc: Allows members to be more easily heard in voice channels by automatically lowering the volume of others while speaking.
detail.perm_mute_members_desc: Allows members to mute other members in voice channels for everyone.
detail.perm_deafen_members_desc: Allows members to deafen other members in voice channels, meaning they won't be able to speak or hear others.
detail.perm_move_members_desc: Allows members to disconnect or move other members between voice channels they have access to.
detail.perm_manage_plugins_desc: Allows members to install, configure, enable, or remove plugins and approve plugin permission manifests in this group.
detail.perm_use_plugins_desc: Allows members to interact with enabled plugins and run plugin commands.
detail.perm_create_events_desc: Allows members to create scheduled group events.
detail.perm_manage_events_desc: Allows members to edit and cancel scheduled group events.
detail.perm_administrator_desc: Members with this permission will have every permission and will also bypass all channel-specific permissions or restrictions (for example, getting access to all private channels). This is a dangerous permission to grant.
detail.add_members_coming_soon: Assigning members to roles will be available when custom roles ship.
detail.everyone_members_notice: All group members automatically belong to @everyone.
detail.members_empty: No members found for this role.
